name: SubtaskRow
purpose: A subtask in the task inspector's Subtasks section. It recurses into its own children, indented per level. The checkbox toggles done; the title button selects that subtask. Kept separate from TaskRow and TaskTreeRow because the check is a square checkbox, the title is a separate button, and the row is a compact 28px. Sources: A. B folded this into TaskRow with a round check.
base: Radix Checkbox (shadcn Checkbox) for the checkbox.

props.name: title
props.description: Subtask title, muted with strikethrough when done.

props.name: depth
props.description: Nesting level. Left padding 6px (0.4286rem) at depth 0; each further level adds 18px (1.2857rem).

props.name: children
props.description: Nested SubtaskRow items for the next level.

props.name: onSelectTask
props.description: Title button click; selects that subtask task.

states: hover (wash-1 background on the rounded field)
role: listitem containing a checkbox (aria-checked) and a title button, with a nested list for children.
keyboard: Tab moves to the checkbox, then the title button. Space toggles the checkbox. Enter on the title button selects the subtask.
platform: Same on web and desktop. Desktop: the task inspector may be a separate window (a container decision); the row is identical on both platforms.
open: 1) The row is 28px tall (h-8 = 2rem at 1rem=14px). B's compact density is this fixed height. The font is not recorded; the 500 weight of the other rows is assumed. 2) Conflict: A records a square checkbox for the subtask check; B puts inspector subtasks on the round check. A kept (the checkbox is recorded on purpose); confirm. 3) Recursion depth limit not recorded. 4) Conflict on indent: A's 6px base plus 18px per further level is kept for the inspector; B folded it into 24px per level. Confirm the inspector indent against the reference.
